# Esther Chapter 8 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 458r–458v | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/EST_008_page_001.jpg

---

**8:1** On-that day [ba-yom ha-hu] the-king Achashverosh gave [natan] to-Ester the-queen the-house [beyt] of-Haman, the-adversary [tsorer] of-the-Yehudim. And-Mordekhai came before [lifney] the-king, for Ester had-told [higgidah] what he [was] to-her. **8:2** And-the-king removed [va-yasar] his-signet-ring [tabe'ato] which he-had-taken [he'evir] from-Haman, and-he-gave-it [va-yittenah] to-Mordekhai. And-Ester set [va-tasem] Mordekhai over the-house of-Haman.

**8:3** And-Ester spoke again [va-tosef] before [lifney] the-king, and-she-fell [va-tippol] before his-feet [lifney raglav], and-she-wept [va-tevk] and-she-pleaded [va-titchannen] to-him to-remove [le-ha'avir] the-evil [ra'at] of-Haman the-Agagi and his-plot [machashavto] which he-had-plotted [chashav] against the-Yehudim. **8:4** And-the-king extended [va-yoshet] to-Ester the-scepter [sharbit] of-gold [ha-zahav], and-Ester arose [va-taqom] and-stood [va-ta'amod] before [lifney] the-king. **8:5** And-she-said, "If upon the-king [it-is] good [tov], and-if I-have-found favor [chen] before-him, and-the-thing [ha-davar] [is] proper [kasher] before the-king, and-I [am] good [tovah] in-his-eyes, let-it-be-written [yikkathev] to-return [le-hashiv] the-letters [ha-sefarim], the-plot [machashevet] of-Haman son of-Hammedatha the-Agagi, which he-wrote [katav] to-destroy [le-abbed] the-Yehudim who [are] in-all the-provinces [medinot] of-the-king. **8:6** For how [ki eikhakhah] can-I-bear [ukhal] to-look [ve-ra'iti] on-the-evil [be-ra'ah] that will-find [yimtsa] my-people [ammi]? And-how can-I-bear to-look on-the-destruction [be-ovdan] of-my-kindred [moladti]?"

**8:7** And-the-king Achashverosh said to-Ester the-queen and-to Mordekhai the-Yehudi, "Behold, the-house of-Haman I-have-given [natatti] to-Ester, and-him they-have-hanged [talu] on the-gallows [ha-ets], because [al asher] he-stretched [shalach] his-hand [yado] against the-Yehudim. **8:8** And-you [ve-attem], write [kitvu] concerning the-Yehudim as-[is]-good [ka-tov] in-your-eyes [be-einekhem] in-the-name [be-shem] of-the-king, and-seal [ve-chitmu] with-the-signet-ring [be-tabe'at] of-the-king; for a-writing [khetav] which is-written [nichtav] in-the-name of-the-king and-sealed [ve-nachtom] with-the-signet-ring of-the-king — there-is-no [ein] revoking [le-hashiv]."

**8:9** And-the-scribes [sofrey] of-the-king were-called [va-yiqqare'u] at-that time [ba-et ha-hi], in-the-third [ha-shelishi] month [chodesh] — it [is] the-month [chodesh] of-Sivan — on-the-twenty-third [bi-sheloshah ve-esrim] day in-it, and-it-was-written according-to-all [ke-khol] that Mordekhai commanded [tsivvah] to the-Yehudim and-to the-satraps [ha-achashdarpanim] and-the-governors [ha-pachot] and-the-princes [sarey] of-the-provinces [ha-medinot] which [are] from-Hoddu to-Kush, seven and-twenty and-a-hundred provinces [medinah], province [medinah] and-province according-to-its-writing [ki-khetavah], and-people [am] and-people according-to-its-language [ki-leshonam], and-to the-Yehudim according-to-their-writing and-according-to-their-language.

**8:10** And-he-wrote [va-yikhtov] in-the-name of-the-king Achashverosh, and-he-sealed [va-yachtom] with-the-signet-ring of-the-king, and-he-sent [va-yishlach] letters [sefarim] by-the-hand [be-yad] of-the-runners [ha-ratsim] on-the-horses [ba-susim], riders [rokhvey] of-the-steeds [ha-rekhesh], the-royal-bred [beney ha-rammakhim]. **8:11** That the-king granted [natan] to-the-Yehudim who [were] in-every [be-khol] city [ir] and-city to-assemble [le-hiqqahel] and-to-stand [ve-la'amod] for their-lives [al-nafsham], to-destroy [le-hashmid] and-to-slay [la-harog] and-to-annihilate [u-le'abbed] every [kol] force [cheil] of-people [am] and-province [medinah] the-ones-attacking [ha-tsarim] them, children [taf] and-women [ve-nashim], and-their-plunder [u-shelalam] to-take-as-spoil [lavoz].

**8:12** On-one [be-yom echad] day in-all the-provinces [medinot] of-the-king Achashverosh, on-the-thirteenth [bi-sheloshah asar] day of-the-twelfth [le-chodesh shnem asar] month — it [is] the-month of-Adar. **8:13** A-copy [patshegen] of-the-writing [ha-khetav] to-be-given [le-hinnaten] as-law [dat] in-every [be-khol] province and-province, revealed [galuy] to-all the-peoples [ha-ammim], and-for the-Yehudim to-be ready [atidim] for-this day [la-yom ha-zeh] to-take-vengeance [le-hiqqahem] from their-enemies [me-oyveyhem].

**8:14** The-runners [ha-ratsim], riders [rokhvey] of-the-steeds [ha-rekhesh], went-out [yatse'u] hurried [mevuhalim] and-pressed [ve-dechufim] by-the-word [bi-devar] of-the-king, and-the-law [ha-dat] was-given [nittenah] in-Shushan [be-Shushan] the-citadel [ha-birah].

**8:15** And-Mordekhai went-out [yatsa] from-before [mi-lifney] the-king in-royal [malkhut] clothing [levush] of-blue [tekheleth] and-white [ve-chur], and-a-great [gedolah] crown [atarah] of-gold [zahav], and-a-robe [ve-takhrikh] of-fine-linen [buts] and-purple [ve-argaman]; and-the-city [ha-ir] of-Shushan cried-out [tsahalah] and-rejoiced [ve-samechah]. **8:16** For-the-Yehudim there-was light [orah] and-gladness [ve-simchah] and-joy [ve-sasson] and-honor [vi-yqar]. **8:17** And-in-every province and-province and-in-every city and-city, the-place [meqom] where the-word [devar] of-the-king and-his-law [ve-dato] reached [maggia], [there was] gladness [simchah] and-joy [ve-sasson] for-the-Yehudim, a-feast [mishteh] and-a-good [tov] day [yom]. And-many from-the-peoples [me-ammey] of-the-land [ha-arets] were-becoming-Jews [mityahadim], for the-fear [pachad] of-the-Yehudim had-fallen [nafal] upon-them.

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.9 — "ha-achashdarpanim":** This is a Persian loanword (*khshatrapavan*) for provincial governors/satraps, one of many Persian administrative terms preserved in the Hebrew text of Esther. The Leningrad Codex preserves the full transliteration.

**v.11 — Mirrored decree language:** The Hebrew deliberately echoes the language of Haman's original decree (3:13) — *le-hashmid, la-harog, u-le'abbed* (to destroy, to slay, and to annihilate) — now turned in the Jews' favor. The verbal reversal is precise and intentional.

**v.16 — "orah" (light):** The fourfold expression *orah ve-simchah ve-sasson vi-yqar* (light and gladness and joy and honor) is one of the most celebrated phrases in Esther, recited in the Havdalah ceremony. The Talmud (Megillah 16b) interprets these as Torah, festival, circumcision, and tefillin respectively.

**v.17 — "mityahadim" (becoming-Jews):** This unusual reflexive verb form (*hitpa'el* of *yahad*) occurs only here in the Hebrew Bible. It implies conversion or at minimum public identification with the Jewish community — a remarkable social reversal.

*— EMET*
